faq.question: How many points do I score for a monastery tile—1 point per surrounding tile plus 1 for the monastery, or something else?
faq.answer: You score 1 point for each surrounding tile, plus 1 additional point for the monastery tile itself. For example, a monastery with 4 surrounding tiles scores 5 points total.
faq.source_quote: You score 1 point for each surrounding tiles, as well as the monastery tile.
